notes.text: The 100% checklist opens only after the story, though story progress already counts toward it.
Seen as the hardest trophy, eating roughly 100 hours of the platinum run on its own.
Nothing on the checklist can be missed, and the bar sits around 60% of true completion.
Sample targets: 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and all 42 range golds.
